newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut's BBC bank issues $12 mln EuroCDs.
newsitem.headline: Beirut's BBC bank issues $12 mln EuroCDs.

text.p: Beirut finance house Lebanon Invest announced on Wednesday a $12 million issue of one-year dollar-denominated certificates of deposit by Banque Beyrouth pour le Commerce (BBC).
Placement abroad and in Lebanon of the EuroCDs began on Tuesday and the issue date was set at October 21, Lebanon Invest Senior Business Development Manager Omar Jaroudi told Reuters.
"There is a good reaction so far. Seventy-five percent of the placement is going to Lebanese abroad and to institutions," he said.
Interest on the CDs is set at 8.25 percent, 200 basis points over similar U.S. Treasuries.
Jaroudi said the bank would use the proceeds for general purposes, including consumer loans.

BBC, which ranked 17th last year among Lebanon's 82 banks in terms of customer deposits, is among several Lebanese banks that have recently sought equity or debt financing on the international markets.
